Home.title: Care, scheduled with clarity
Home.description: Book specialists, manage availability, and keep clinical history secure.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Thaydee Elena (yelena-booking) is a clinical booking and records app. This policy describes what data we process and why.
Privacy.dataBody: Account data (email, name, role), clinical profile and appointments, medical documents you upload, and technical logs needed to run the service (e.g. Firebase authentication).
Privacy.googleBody: If a specialist connects Google Calendar, we only request calendar events and FreeBusy access to avoid double-booking and to create/update/cancel appointment events. We do not read Gmail, Contacts, or Drive. You can disconnect Calendar anytime from the specialist panel.
Privacy.storageBody: Data is stored in Firebase/Firestore and clinical files in private storage (Vercel Blob). Access to clinical documents requires authentication.
Privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction, or deletion of account data by contacting the service owner. Clinical documents follow an append-only clinical archive model except where required by law or agreed admin processes.
Privacy.contactBody: Data controller / app developer: erickorso@gmail.com. For privacy questions or rights requests, email that address.

GoogleCalendar.title: Your Google Calendar
GoogleCalendar.subtitle: Thaydee Elena won’t offer times when you’re already busy, and can create a Meet link when someone books.
GoogleCalendar.step2: Sign in with the Google account you use for your work calendar (Gmail / Workspace).
GoogleCalendar.step3: When Google asks, allow access to view and edit your calendar.
GoogleCalendar.step4: You’ll return here automatically. If you see your email, you’re done.
GoogleCalendar.benefit1: Busy times on Google won’t show as available.
GoogleCalendar.benefit2: New appointments are saved to your Google Calendar.
GoogleCalendar.benefit3: When Google allows it, a Meet link is created for the patient.
GoogleCalendar.privacyNote: We only use your calendar for bookings. You can disconnect anytime.
